title: DataBall opens must stage through one path and reconcile metadata in one planner
lead: `OpenOneAsync` keeps only the snapshot-pointer, native `.ball` and single Parquet-view routes. Every other single source (CSV, copied Parquet, layout-config Parquet, parsing handler) stages through `StageSourcesAsync` and merges through `MergeStagedSources`, exactly as a many-file open does. One internal metadata planner decides each configured metadata field's level for the many-file merge (`ReconcileSourceMetadata`), the wide append (`ExtractConfiguredMetadata` and `DuckDbStore.ApplyMetadataAgainstSource`) and the layout append (the `PlanAppend` demotion loop); append semantics are unchanged. `Bounce` skips per-source columns. `BackfillFromSource` decides the column type with `DecideColumnMerge` and throws a named conflict. A skipped source's handler overlay no longer shapes the config.

Owner decisions (2026-10-12, spec review): (D1) one planner, append rule kept: an append whose constant differs from stored Metadata still demotes the field to a row column with the old value backfilled; appends do not join the three levels. (D2) After staging, if a skipped source's handler overlay changed the effective config, resolve the config again from the surviving sources and restage them once, so the session equals opening the survivors alone; no restage when the skipped sources contributed no overlay change. (D3) A single handler file is staged like any other source: rows go to staging in batches, then one merge transaction; the last parsed row is still remembered for `InitializeRow`; `AfterHandlerBatchForTests` fires per staged batch. (D4) A single-file open that fails under `Abort` throws the many-file wording `Cannot open '<path>': …`; tests asserting the old raw messages are updated.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** native .ball sources in many-file opens (db-25); structured cast errors (db-12); appends joining the three metadata levels (D1); per-source columns travelling through MergeOrAppend or native import.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Created from the db-11 architect findings and the db-24 relay. Open has two pipelines below the one entry and metadata is decided in three loops, so policies (bad-file, db-24), strict casts (db-12) and transforms (db-13) would each have to be attached twice. One staging loop and one planner give them one place. Bounce and the source backfill are the two known inconsistencies left by db-11.

**Model note (owner, 2026-10-12):** Claude-only relay, full (size M). Implementer: **Sonnet 5.5, high**; precise file-scoped fix rounds: **Haiku 5.5, xhigh**. Reviewer and architect: Opus 5.5, medium. Gate: Sonnet 5.5, medium. The run ends landed (merged to main, not pushed).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/DataBall/DataBall.Open.cs`: `OpenOneAsync` shrinks to pointer, native and Parquet view; `ResolveOpenConfig` can resolve from a subset of routes.
- `src/DataBall/DataBall.OpenMany.cs`: the single-source route through staging, D4 wording, the D2 restage, last-row memory for a handler source, `ReconcileSourceMetadata` on the planner.
- New internal planner (e.g. `src/DataBall/MetadataPlanner.cs`): per-field decision (Metadata, source column, row column, demote, leave) from profiles, policy and stored state; the callers execute the decision.
- `src/DataBall/DataBall.cs`: `ExtractConfiguredMetadata` on the planner; `ExtractConstantsToMetadataSql` (Bounce) skips per-source columns of `source`.
- `src/DataBall/DuckDbStore.cs`: `ApplyMetadataAgainstSource` on the planner; `BackfillFromSource` / `AppendFromTable` type decision.
- `src/DataBall/DuckDbStore.Layout.cs`: `PlanAppend` demotion on the planner; layout backfill type decision.
- Tests under `tests/DataBall.Tests/` (`MultiFileOpenTests`, `HandlerTests`, metadata, append and lineage tests).
- `README.md` and `docs/how-it-works.md` (§5 metadata, §14 opening many files, the handler-drain paragraph in "Columnar and streaming reads", §9 if the append wording changes).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `Open_SingleCsv_StagesLikeMany`: a single CSV opened alone gives the same columns, types, Metadata, `source` row and `OpenReport` as before and as the staged route; also with a config `tables` layout (split once).
2. `Open_SingleHandler_Staged_RemembersLastRow`: a single handler file is staged and merged in one transaction (a failure mid-parse leaves no session), `AfterHandlerBatchForTests` fires per staged batch, and a later `InitializeRow` copies the last parsed row.
3. `Open_SingleFile_Abort_NamesSource`: a single CSV that does not parse throws `Cannot open '<path>': …` under `Abort`; no session, the open-file gate is clear.
4. `Open_SkippedHandlerOverlay_DoesNotShapeConfig`: under `Skip`, a file whose handler overlay adds a typed column or metadata field fails parsing; the session's config, schema and Metadata equal opening the surviving files alone.
5. `Bounce_SkipsPerSourceColumn`: after a many-file open makes a per-source column and an append makes it a constant row column, `Bounce` leaves it out of Metadata.
6. `Append_BackfillFromSource_TypeConflict_Throws`: a per-source column whose `source` type and incoming type cannot merge throws a named conflict (both types, the column, the source) and leaves the session as it was. `Append_BackfillFromSource_Widens`: mergeable types give the merged type, values intact.
7. `MetadataPlanner_*`: decision tests for liftConstant, requireConstant, first and bounce across the open, wide-append and layout-append call sites (constant, varying, all-null, stored-equal, stored-differing, session column, per-source column, layout key, handler field).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Spec review against the code; stop on any gap.
2. `slicer start db-27 --render --strict`. Write tests 1–7 and watch each fail for the stated reason.
3. Implement; README and `docs/how-it-works.md` in the same change; mutation-check every new test; full Release suite; format.

Must not change: pointer, native and single Parquet-view opens keep the attached view and its pushdown; append demotion behavior (D1); merge-conflict wording; a failed open leaves no session, temporary store, extraction folder or gate reservation; `OpenReport` for single opens (apart from D4 wording). Existing tests stay green unchanged except message assertions covered by D4 and the per-batch-transaction tests covered by D3.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build DataBall.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test DataBall.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format DataBall.sln --verify-no-changes`
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `db-27` in `.worktrees/db-27`. The orchestrator commits and merges after the gate passes.
